sentence_stem: Most students prefer printed textbooks, whereas
full_sentence: Most students prefer printed textbooks, whereas others prefer digital ones.
acceptable_variants: a few enjoy reading on screens.

options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'whereas' signals a contrast between two groups of students.
This does not contrast with the preference stated in the first clause, so 'whereas' has no logical link to it.

options.text: most students prefer printed books too.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the first clause instead of contrasting with it, so 'whereas' would sound unnatural.

grammar_focus: Contrastive connector 'whereas' followed by a clause that sets up a clear contrast
explanation: Speakers may treat this connector as a simple 'and', but English 'whereas' requires a clause that sets up a clear contrast with the first clause, usually a different group or preference.
translation: Більшість студентів віддають перевагу друкованим підручникам, тоді як інші віддають перевагу цифровим.
